fixture.baseCommitRule: Copy the Fixture, run npm test and the absolute documentation synchronization and check commands, initialize Git, commit every resulting Fixture file, and verify a clean tree before delivering the original user request.

dimensions.criterion: Confirm the initial assessment compares the full SPEC-028 Bundle with runtime source, tests, caller, persisted configuration, and cleanup surfaces, identifying each present semantic deviation category.
Confirm each reported finding includes severity, a controlling Spec, Plan, or Task reference, direct file-and-line evidence, and a practical repair direction.
Confirm no file changes precede the audit stop, then the authorized amendment appends complete unchecked Tasks to the existing file and returns its lifecycle state to pending review before stopping.
Confirm only the existing Tasks file and CLI-generated Indexes may change after authorization, while implementation, upstream documents, and unrelated project material remain unchanged.

hardRejects: treats checked Tasks or passing tests as proof without comparing the full Bundle and project tree
reports a material finding without severity, controlling reference, file-and-line evidence, and an implementable repair direction
changes a file during the initial read-only assessment or creates a separate audit report
amends Tasks before the initial audit stop or replaces existing Task content instead of appending directly implementable work
fails to return the amended Tasks document to revision 5, pending-review approval, null approved revision, and pending status
changes implementation, upstream documents, or anything other than the permitted Tasks file and generated Indexes after authorization

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the original read-only convergence audit request is delivered
the Implementer has reported a traceable read-only audit in chat, made no file changes, and stopped
rounds.message: 同意把刚才审计中可直接实施的偏差和清理项追加到现有 tasks.md。保留既有历史，把 Tasks 更新为 revision 5、approval pending-review、approved_revision null、status pending；新 Task 全部不勾选，运行 docs sync 后停下来等我重新审核。不要修改实现或上游文档。

criticalPath: Inspect the Bundle and all relevant project surfaces, report the first file-and-line-backed semantic deviation, then wait for authorization before any Tasks amendment.
